result.instructions: Tools for Avirato, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who checks in at my hotel tomorrow and who checks out?"; "Which rooms are free from 12 to 15 November?"; "How much is a double room on the standard rate for 3 nights from 20 December, 2 adults?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Avirato data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run avirato_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run avirato_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run avirato_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. avirato_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: avirato_list_reservations
tools.title: List reservations between dates
tools.description: Reservations of the establishment between two dates (reservation id, channel booking id, room, rate, guest name and document, check-in/out, price, paid and outstanding, status, notes) plus a summary of counts by status. Dates are whole days (yyyy-mm-dd) or exact date-times. GET /reservation/betweenDates.

start_date.description: First day (yyyy-mm-dd) or date-time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss) of the range.

end_date.description: Last day (yyyy-mm-dd, through 23:59:59) or date-time of the range.

tools.name: avirato_get_reservation
tools.title: Get a reservation
tools.description: One reservation by the hotel's own booking id, or by a channel's booking id together with the channel (operator) id. Returns the booking(s) with guest, room, rate, dates, price, paid and outstanding amounts and status. Card data is never returned. GET /reservation/{bookingId}.

booking_id.description: The hotel's booking id, or a channel's (operator's) booking id.

operator_id.description: The channel (operator) id when booking_id is a channel's booking id. See avirato_list_booking_channels.

tools.name: avirato_get_reservation_details
tools.title: Get reservation details
tools.description: Extended information of one reservation by its booking id (the reservationInfo view). Card data is never returned. GET /reservation/reservationInfo.

tools.name: avirato_get_related_reservations
tools.title: Get related reservations
tools.description: A reservation with the other reservations of the same group (master booking and its related rooms). Card data is never returned. GET /reservation/related/{reservationId}.

tools.name: avirato_list_all_reservations
tools.title: List all reservations
tools.description: Every reservation of the establishment in the PMS (can be a very large list for an old hotel; prefer avirato_list_reservations with a date range). Returns `limit` entries from `offset` (default the first 100), the total count and next_offset. Card data is never returned. GET /reservation/allReservations.

limit.description: How many reservations to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: Skip this many reservations first (default 0); pass the previous reply's next_offset to read on.

tools.name: avirato_list_booking_channels
tools.title: List booking channels
tools.description: The sales channels (operators: OTAs, own website, ...) that book into the establishment, with their operator ids (used by avirato_get_reservation). GET /reservation/operators.

tools.name: avirato_check_availability
tools.title: Check availability
tools.description: Availability of rooms for a stay: which room types and rooms are free between check-in and check-out, optionally limited to a room category, rooms, room types or zones. GET /availability.

online_only.description: Only rooms offered for online sale.

with_valid_space_ids.description: Only rooms (spaces) that exist as valid rooms.

space_subtype_ids.description: Only these room type (space subtype) ids.

tools.name: avirato_list_available_spaces
tools.title: List available rooms
tools.description: The free rooms (spaces) of one room category between two dates. GET /availability/availableSpaces.

space_type_id.description: Room category id (space type). See avirato_get_booking_engine_overview.

tools.name: avirato_get_unavailable_dates
tools.title: Get unavailable dates of a room
tools.description: The dates a room (space) is not free from a start date on, ignoring the given booking (useful to check whether a booking can be extended or moved). GET /availability/unavailable-dates.

annotations.title: Get unavailable dates of a room

tools.name: avirato_get_booking_engine_overview
tools.title: Get rooms, diets, extras and availability overview
tools.description: The booking-engine start data between two dates: room types with descriptions and availability, meal plans (diets), taxes, extras and billing configuration. The quickest way to learn the room type, space type and rate ids of the establishment. GET /rate/init.

tools.name: avirato_list_rates
tools.title: List rates
tools.description: The rates of the establishment (name, minimum/maximum stay, refundable, linked rate and percentage, release days, room category), optionally only some rate ids and one rate mode. GET /rate.

tools.name: avirato_list_rates_by_room_category
tools.title: List rates by room category
tools.description: All rates of the establishment, optionally limited to some rate ids and room categories (space types). GET /rate/all.

space_type_ids.description: Only these room category (space type) ids.

tools.name: avirato_get_rate
tools.title: Get a rate
tools.description: One rate by id: name, stay limits, refundable, linked and master rate, release days and mode. GET /rate/{rateId}.

tools.name: avirato_get_price
tools.title: Get the price of a stay
tools.description: The final price of a stay for one room type and rate, with discounts and increments applied, for a number of adults, children, meal plan and rooms. GET /rate/getPrice.

diet.description: Meal plan (diet) id; 0 = none. List them with avirato_list_diets.

num_rooms.description: Total rooms in the booking (used for discounts; default 1).

annotations.title: Get the price of a stay

tools.name: avirato_get_prices_map
tools.title: Get a price calendar
tools.description: Prices per room type and rate for each day of a period, with the establishment's taxes. GET /rate/getPricesMap.

tools.name: avirato_get_discounts
tools.title: Get discounts
tools.description: The discounts and increments that apply to room types and rates for a period and a number of rooms. GET /rate/discounts.

tools.name: avirato_list_diets
tools.title: List meal plans
tools.description: The meal plans (diets) of the establishment with their ids, as used by the price tools. GET /rate/diets.

tools.name: avirato_list_rate_releases
tools.title: List rate release days
tools.description: The release (minimum advance booking) days of each rate. GET /rate/release.

tools.name: avirato_get_minimum_stay
tools.title: Get minimum stay restrictions
tools.description: The minimum-stay restrictions per day for room types and rates over a period. GET /restrictions/minimum-stay.

final_date.description: Last day of the period, yyyy-mm-dd.

initial_date.description: First day of the period, yyyy-mm-dd.

space_subtype_ids.description: Only these room type (space subtype) ids.

tools.name: avirato_get_daily_prices
tools.title: Get daily prices of a rate
tools.description: The daily prices of one rate on one date (per room type and occupancy). GET /dailyPrice.

annotations.title: Get daily prices of a rate

tools.name: avirato_list_promotional_packages
tools.title: List promotional packages
tools.description: The promotional packages of the establishment with their extras. GET /payment/promotionalPackages.

tools.name: avirato_list_extras
tools.title: List extras
tools.description: The extras (additional services) that can be charged on a booking. GET /payment/extras.

tools.name: avirato_add_booking_cash_payment
tools.title: Record a cash payment on a booking
tools.description: WRITE: records a cash payment on an existing booking in the hotel's PMS (it changes the booking's paid and outstanding amounts and cannot be undone through this server). Not idempotent: calling it twice records two payments. Confirm the booking id and the amount with the user first, then pass confirm: true. If the call fails with a network error or timeout the payment may still have been recorded: read the booking (avirato_get_reservation) and check its payments before trying again. Card payments are not supported. POST /payment/addBookingPayment.

amount.description: Payment amount in the establishment's currency; must not be 0.

datetime.description: When the payment was received, yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss (default: now, UTC).

confirm.description: Must be true: you confirm the user asked to record exactly this payment on this booking.

annotations.title: Record a cash payment on a booking
